neighbours.label: the token just before an expected 'production'/'output' (raise oil ..., increase ..., stimulates the ...): a predictor of the production noun; the same verbs aimed at non-production nouns stay low
fire: New drilling should help the country raise oil production by next spring.
The plant hopes to increase output once the second line is running.
This vitamin stimulates the production of red blood cells.
Cheap credit allowed farmers to boost grain production after the drought.
The ministry wants to increase output from the northern gas fields.
Sunlight on the skin triggers the production of vitamin D.
Investors expect the mine to double copper production within two years.
Low rainfall caused a decline in rice production across the delta.
quiet: New drilling should help the country raise its credit rating by next spring.
The plant hopes to hire more staff once the second line is running.
This vitamin keeps the skin and eyes healthy.
Cheap credit allowed farmers to buy new tractors after the drought.
The ministry wants to protect wildlife near the northern gas fields.
Sunlight on the skin can cause burns in summer.
Investors expect the mine to close within two years.
Low rainfall caused a decline in tourist numbers across the delta.

notes: Card: Arabic production texts dominate (يزيد before الانتاج, في before الانتاج), plus 'stable/pro' before 'd'; the opposite pole suppresses ' production'. Probe: 'increase output' 0.340 (on increase), 'stimulates the production' 0.303 (on the), 'raise oil production' 0.271 (on oil), 'agricultural production' 0.146, 'tourist visits' 0.029; my Arabic sentence scored only 0.004, so the test is in English.
